theorems.name: Tetrahedral face-parity identity
theorems.statement: The four face holonomies of any six-edge F2 chirality connection have even parity.

theorems.name: Gauge invariance
theorems.statement: Independent local slice-frame flips change edge signs by a coboundary and leave all four face holonomies fixed.

theorems.name: Exact chirality obstruction sequence
theorems.statement: The curvature map is onto the eight even face patterns, every fiber has eight raw connections, and flatness is exactly a vertex coboundary.

theorems.name: Three-bit complete gauge invariant
theorems.statement: The rooted defects (h012,h013,h023) completely classify the eight gauge orbits of edge connections.

theorems.name: Global J criterion
theorems.statement: A global signed chiral generator exists iff all triangle holonomies vanish; the trivializing vertex potential is unique up to the simultaneous global flip.

theorems.name: Rooted normal form
theorems.statement: Every connection has the canonical representative (0,0,0,h012,h013,h023) after subtracting the rooted tree flat extension.

theorems.name: Two-face repair theorem
theorems.statement: Every two-frustrated-face pattern has a unique one-edge repair.

theorems.name: Fully frustrated repair theorem
theorems.statement: The all-four-frustrated class requires two edge flips and has exactly three minimum repairs, the three opposite-edge pairs.

theorems.name: Euler half-turn blindness
theorems.statement: The half-turn endpoint (-1,0) is fixed by every chirality transport and therefore cannot detect the obstruction.

theorems.name: Quarter-turn and winding detection
theorems.statement: A signed quarter-turn and nonzero signed winding globalize exactly when the chirality connection is flat.

theorems.name: O(2) Euler local system
theorems.statement: Sign-preserving overlaps act identically and sign-reversing overlaps act by conjugation; the even Euler channel always descends while the odd channel descends iff the obstruction vanishes.

theorems.name: Incidence-only no-go
theorems.statement: Bare K4 incidence determines the coboundary and curvature operators but supplies no overlap intertwiner; the effective gauge group acts freely and transitively on flat connections, so no gauge-natural flat connection can be selected from incidence alone.
